;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****The first [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|COVID-19 death]] is confirmed in [[Canada]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/covid-19-coronavirus-update-bc-march-9-1.5483932 (CBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
****Women in Mexico march despite COVID-19 concerns and protests being cancelled in other parts of the world due to concerns over the spread of the disease. [https://www.npr.org/2020/03/08/813477367/international-womens-day-2020-clashes-coronavirus-and-women-prepare-to-strike (NPR)]
****Women protest femicides in all major cities in Mexico, despite raise of COVID-19 cases. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/mexico-international-womens-day-march-femicide-strike/2020/03/08/1ca6167c-6153-11ea-8a8e-5c5336b32760_story.html (The Washington Post)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Connecticut]]
*****[[Connecticut]] confirms its first case of [[COVID-19]] in [[Wilton, Connecticut|Wilton]], which is believed to have been contracted during a trip to [[California]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/08/nyregion/coronavirus-connecticut.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Albania]]
****[[Albania]] reports its first case. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-albania/albania-confirms-first-coronavirus-cases-in-father-and-son-back-from-italy-idUSKBN20W012 (Reuters)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Moldova]]
****[[Moldova]] reports its first case. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-moldova/moldova-reports-first-coronavirus-case-idUSKBN20V08U (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Chief of Staff of the Italian Army]] [[Salvatore Farina (soldier)|Salvatore Farina]] tests positive for COVID-19 and self-isolates, as well as [[President of Piedmont]] [[Alberto Cirio]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-europe-51789355/page/2 (BBC News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic lockdown in Italy]]
*****[[Prime Minister of Italy|Italian Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]] extends the [[quarantine]] lockdown, to cover all the [[regions of Italy|region]] of [[Lombardy]] and 14 other [[Northern Italy|northern]] [[Provinces of Italy|provinces]], affecting over a quarter of the national population. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-51787238 (BBC News)]
*****The number of virus-related deaths in [[Italy]] rise to 366, while the confirmed cases are 7,375. [https://tg24.sky.it/cronaca/2020/03/08/coronavirus-italia-news-diretta.html (Sky Tg24)]
*****Inmates at several prisons in Italy revolt with reports of riots at prisons in [[Modena]], [[Foggia]], [[Naples]], [[Frosinone]] and [[Alessandria]] due to fears the coronavirus lockdowns will end visits from relatives. At least eight inmates, six in Modena, have died of [[overdose]] after assaulting the prison's pharmacy, while about 20 escaped in Foggia. [https://www.open.online/2020/03/09/coronavirus-rivolta-in-un-carcere-di-modena-morto-un-detenuto/ (Open)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[President of Portugal]] [[Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa]] self-isolates after a COVID-19 case is confirmed in a school he visited a few days ago. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2020-03-08/portugals-president-self-isolates-amid-virus-outbreak (''U.S. News & World Report'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****Three new COVID-19 cases are registered in [[Russia]] (one is in [[Kaliningrad Region]], one is in [[Belgorod Region]], one is in [[Moscow Region]]). All of them visited Italy within the past 14 days. [https://sputniknews.com/russia/202003081078511973-three-new-covid-19-cases-registered-in-russia/ (Sputnik)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]] 
***Twenty-seven people have died from methanol poisoning in Iran after rumors that drinking alcohol can help cure the coronavirus infection, state news agency IRNA reported on Monday. [https://www.bolnews.com/international/2020/03/bootleg-booze-kills-27-in-iran-after-coronavirus-cure-rumours/ (BOL News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[California]] [[U.S. Senator]] and former presidential candidate [[Kamala Harris]] endorses former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]] in [[Joe Biden 2020 presidential campaign|his campaign]] for the Democratic nomination for the presidency. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/08/us/politics/kamala-harris-endorses-joe-biden.html (''The New York Times'')]
**Civil rights activist [[Jesse Jackson]] endorses [[Vermont]] [[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[Bernie Sanders]] in [[Bernie Sanders 2020 presidential campaign|his campaign]] for the Democratic nomination for the presidency. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/08/us/politics/jesse-jackson-bernie-sanders-michigan.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Law and crime

[https://sputniknews.com/latam/202003081078514037-women-march-against-violence-in-mexico-city-ahead-of-24-hour-strike-on-monday---video/ (Sputnik)]
